shortDescription: Unzips compressed files and archives on the Windows node

options.name: creates
options.description: If this file or directory exists the specified src will not be extracted.

options.name: delete_archive
options.description: Remove the zip file, after unzipping.

options.name: dest
options.description: Destination of zip file (provide absolute path of directory). If it does not exist, the directory will be created.

options.name: password
options.description: If a zip file is encrypted with password. Passing a value to a password parameter requires the PSCX module to be installed.

options.name: recurse
options.description: Recursively expand zipped files within the src file. Setting to a value of C(yes) requires the PSCX module to be installed.

options.name: src
options.description: File to be unzipped (provide absolute path).
